selection: mean RMSE across 5 assets and 5 folds, shared C and epsilon
history_rule: anchor - max(window_closes-1,24) >= block_start; fixed before rerun
target_rule: anchor + horizon_hours <= block_end; fixed before rerun
learning_curve_rule: prefix fractions of training calendar; histories and targets contained in each prefix
test_policy: reserved; future evaluation must apply the same strict containment within TEST without DEVELOPMENT context
negative_predictions: retained, report count; no post-hoc clipping
budget: 6 configurations x 5 folds x 5 assets; sequential CPU; no adaptive search extension
